summary.text: Keenen Altic is the Green Party candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside incumbent Paul Lowe (D) and Peter Antinozzi (R).
He earned an associate degree in sustainable technology from Cape Fear Community College and has worked in food service, computer-aided drafting and as a forklift operator.

paragraphs.text: Keenen Altic earned an associate degree in sustainable technology from Cape Fear Community College in December 2015.
His professional experience includes working in food service, in computer aided drafting, and as a forklift operator, and he has served as a volunteer for the Farm Labor Organizing Committee.
Altic was the Green Party candidate for the Forsyth County Board of Commissioners At-Large seat in 2018, receiving 3.5% of the vote as incumbent Ted Kaplan (D) won.

In a 2018 Ballotpedia biographical submission, he described his political philosophy as critical of capitalism and listed rent control tied to wages and public education funded according to teacher and student needs among his positions.
